home.seoDescription: Free online Multilevel (CEFR) English practice tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking in the official format, checked instantly with a score out of 75 and your CEFR level.
home.seoOg: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking in the official Multilevel format, checked instantly.

skillText.LISTENING: Six parts and 35 questions with the recording played as on the day, checked the moment you finish.
skillText.READING: Five passages and 35 questions side by side, with the line that holds each answer shown in the review.

skillText.SPEAKING: Four parts with preparation and speaking timers. Listen back to yourself, get AI feedback, or send it to an examiner.

home.faq1Answer: Yes. Free tests open without an account and are checked instantly. Premium adds the whole library, the explanations behind every answer, and more AI feedback.
home.faq2: How is my score worked out?
home.faq2Answer: Listening and Reading answers are checked against the key and converted to the Multilevel scale out of 75 with the official tables. 65+ is C1, 51+ B2 and 38+ B1.
home.faq3Answer: No. Without one your answers are checked and shown once. Sign in with Telegram or Google to keep your results and have Writing and Speaking marked.
home.faq4: Is it like the real Multilevel exam?
home.faq4Answer: The sections, timings, part structure and question types follow the official format, on a screen laid out the way the exam is.
home.faq5: Does it work on my phone?
home.faq5Answer: Yes. Every test works on a phone: on small screens the passage and the questions switch with one tap.

home.demoFeedbackText: Clear position and well-organised paragraphs. Work on linking ideas within paragraphs and vary your sentence openings.
home.newestText: Free ones open without an account.

home.ctaText: Take a free test now. It takes under an hour, and your score comes the moment you finish.

ai.introSpeaking: An estimated score out of 75 from what you said, as an examiner marks it: fluency, vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation and the task for each part, with your speed and pauses, corrections and better words. About a minute.
ai.introWriting: An estimated score out of 75, how each task did on the four criteria, and the corrections that matter most. About a minute.
ai.wait: Usually under a minute. You can stay here; it appears by itself.
ai.guide: An AI estimate to guide you, not an examiner's mark.

level.C1: You use English flexibly and effectively for social, academic and professional purposes, and follow long, demanding texts.
level.B2: You interact with fluency and spontaneity and understand the main ideas of complex texts. C1 starts at 65.
level.B1: You deal with most everyday situations and understand the main points of clear, standard English. B2 starts at 51.
level.A2: You understand sentences and common expressions on familiar topics. B1, the first level the exam certifies, starts at 38.
